feature_queries.name: brewer_profile
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.brewer_id,
  e.timestamp,
  b.country_id,
  b.state_id,
  b.type_id,
  b.view_count AS brewer_view_count,
  b.score AS brewer_score,
  b.is_retired
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN brewers b
  ON b.brewer_id = e.brewer_id

feature_queries.name: beer_history
feature_queries.sql:
WITH beer_before AS (
  SELECT
    e.brewer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    be.beer_id,
    be.created_at
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN beers be
    ON be.brewer_id = e.brewer_id
   AND be.created_at < e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  brewer_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(beer_id) AS beers_created_total,
  MIN(created_at) AS first_beer_created_at,
  MAX(created_at) AS last_beer_created_at,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(created_at), timestamp) AS days_since_last_beer,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(created_at), timestamp) AS days_since_first_beer
FROM beer_before
GROUP BY brewer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: beer_recency_windows
feature_queries.sql:
WITH beer_before AS (
  SELECT
    e.brewer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    be.created_at
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN beers be
    ON be.brewer_id = e.brewer_id
   AND be.created_at < e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  brewer_id,
  timestamp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS beers_created_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS beers_created_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beers_created_180d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beers_created_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= timestamp - INTERVAL '730 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beers_created_730d
FROM beer_before
GROUP BY brewer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: beer_cadence
feature_queries.sql:
WITH beer_before AS (
  SELECT
    e.brewer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    be.created_at
  FROM eval_table e
  JOIN beers be
    ON be.brewer_id = e.brewer_id
   AND be.created_at < e.timestamp
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    brewer_id,
    timestamp,
    created_at,
    LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY brewer_id, timestamp ORDER BY created_at) AS prev_created_at
  FROM beer_before
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT
    brewer_id,
    timestamp,
    DATE_DIFF('day', prev_created_at, created_at) AS gap_days
  FROM ordered
  WHERE prev_created_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  e.brewer_id,
  e.timestamp,
  AVG(g.gap_days) AS mean_gap_days,
  STDDEV_SAMP(g.gap_days) AS std_gap_days,
  MIN(g.gap_days) AS min_gap_days,
  MAX(g.gap_days) AS max_gap_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN g.gap_days <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_gaps_le_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN g.gap_days <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_gaps_le_30d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN gaps g
  ON g.brewer_id = e.brewer_id
 AND g.timestamp = e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.brewer_id, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: beer_style_recency
feature_queries.sql:
WITH beer_before AS (
  SELECT
    e.brewer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    be.style_id,
    bs.category AS style_category,
    be.created_at
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN beers be
    ON be.brewer_id = e.brewer_id
   AND be.created_at < e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN beer_styles bs
    ON bs.style_id = be.style_id
),
last_beer AS (
  SELECT
    brewer_id,
    timestamp,
    style_category AS last_style_category
  FROM (
    SELECT
      brewer_id,
      timestamp,
      style_category,
      created_at,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brewer_id, timestamp ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn
    FROM beer_before
    WHERE created_at IS NOT NULL
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  bb.brewer_id,
  bb.timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bb.style_id) AS distinct_styles_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bb.created_at >= bb.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN bb.style_id END) AS distinct_styles_365d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bb.style_category) AS distinct_style_categories_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bb.created_at >= bb.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN bb.style_category END) AS distinct_style_categories_365d,
  lb.last_style_category
FROM beer_before bb
LEFT JOIN last_beer lb
  ON lb.brewer_id = bb.brewer_id
 AND lb.timestamp = bb.timestamp
GROUP BY bb.brewer_id, bb.timestamp, lb.last_style_category

feature_queries.name: rating_activity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH beer_before AS (
  SELECT e.brewer_id, e.timestamp, be.beer_id
  FROM eval_table e
  JOIN beers be
    ON be.brewer_id = e.brewer_id
   AND be.created_at < e.timestamp
),
ratings_before AS (
  SELECT
    bb.brewer_id,
    bb.timestamp,
    r.rating_id,
    r.created_at,
    r.total_score
  FROM beer_before bb
  LEFT JOIN beer_ratings r
    ON r.beer_id = bb.beer_id
   AND r.created_at < bb.timestamp
)
SELECT
  brewer_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(rating_id) AS ratings_total,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(created_at), timestamp) AS days_since_last_rating,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratings_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratings_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratings_365d,
  AVG(total_score) AS mean_rating_score
FROM ratings_before
GROUP BY brewer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: quality_shift
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.brewer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days') AS ts_365d
  FROM eval_table e
),
beer_before AS (
  SELECT
    b.brewer_id,
    b.timestamp,
    b.ts_365d,
    be.avg_rating,
    be.rating_count,
    be.created_at
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN beers be
    ON be.brewer_id = b.brewer_id
   AND be.created_at < b.timestamp
)
SELECT
  brewer_id,
  timestamp,
  AVG(CASE WHEN created_at >= ts_365d THEN avg_rating END) AS mean_beer_rating_recent_365d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN created_at < ts_365d THEN avg_rating END) AS mean_beer_rating_older,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= ts_365d THEN COALESCE(rating_count,0) ELSE 0 END) AS sum_rating_count_recent_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at < ts_365d THEN COALESCE(rating_count,0) ELSE 0 END) AS sum_rating_count_older
FROM beer_before
GROUP BY brewer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: rater_diversity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.brewer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days') AS ts_365d
  FROM eval_table e
),
beer_before AS (
  SELECT
    b.brewer_id,
    b.timestamp,
    b.ts_365d,
    be.beer_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN beers be
    ON be.brewer_id = b.brewer_id
   AND be.created_at < b.timestamp
),
ratings_before AS (
  SELECT
    bb.brewer_id,
    bb.timestamp,
    bb.ts_365d,
    r.user_id,
    r.rating_id,
    r.created_at
  FROM beer_before bb
  LEFT JOIN beer_ratings r
    ON r.beer_id = bb.beer_id
   AND r.created_at < bb.timestamp
)
SELECT
  brewer_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS distinct_raters_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN created_at >= ts_365d THEN user_id END) AS distinct_raters_365d
FROM ratings_before
GROUP BY brewer_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: rating_age_buckets
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.brewer_id,
    e.timestamp,
    (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days')  AS ts_30d,
    (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days')  AS ts_90d,
    (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days') AS ts_180d,
    (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days') AS ts_365d
  FROM eval_table e
),
beer_before AS (
  SELECT
    b.brewer_id,
    b.timestamp,
    b.ts_30d,
    b.ts_90d,
    b.ts_180d,
    b.ts_365d,
    be.beer_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN beers be
    ON be.brewer_id = b.brewer_id
   AND be.created_at < b.timestamp
),
ratings_before AS (
  SELECT
    bb.brewer_id,
    bb.timestamp,
    bb.ts_30d,
    bb.ts_90d,
    bb.ts_180d,
    bb.ts_365d,
    r.rating_id,
    r.created_at
  FROM beer_before bb
  LEFT JOIN beer_ratings r
    ON r.beer_id = bb.beer_id
   AND r.created_at < bb.timestamp
)
SELECT
  brewer_id,
  timestamp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= ts_30d THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratings_age_0_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at < ts_30d AND created_at >= ts_90d THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratings_age_30_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at < ts_90d AND created_at >= ts_180d THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratings_age_90_180d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at < ts_180d AND created_at >= ts_365d THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratings_age_180_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN created_at < ts_365d THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratings_age_365plus
FROM ratings_before
GROUP BY brewer_id, timestamp
